galaxyTypes.name: Standard
galaxyTypes.description: Stars scattered evenly; about a third of systems have no planets.

galaxyTypes.name: Sparse
galaxyTypes.description: Habitable worlds are rare: over half the systems have no planets, so every good one is contested.

galaxyTypes.name: Dense
galaxyTypes.description: Planets almost everywhere: a fast land grab and big empires.

galaxyTypes.name: Clusters
galaxyTypes.description: Small groups of closely linked stars, joined to each other by only a lane or two: natural chokepoints.

galaxyTypes.name: Spiral
galaxyTypes.description: Two arms winding out from the core; travel runs along the arms, and the core links them.

galaxyTypes.name: Ring
galaxyTypes.description: A broad ring of stars around an empty middle: the long way round is the only way.

techs.name: Controlled Environments
techs.description: Sealed habitats: colonize Barren worlds (minimum habitability -20).

techs.name: Subterranean Habitats
techs.description: +20% max population on every colony. Unlocks Habitat Domes.

techs.name: Planetary Medicine
techs.description: +20% population growth and +1 max population on every colony.

techs.name: Terraforming
techs.description: Colonize Toxic and Volcanic worlds (minimum habitability -15). +10% max population.

techs.name: Adaptive Physiology
techs.description: Colonists thrive in harsher places: minimum habitability -10, +10% growth.

techs.name: Cyborg Crews
techs.description: Ship crews learn 50% faster from battle.

techs.name: Outpost Construction
techs.description: Unlocks the Outpost Kit: combat outposts on asteroid fields and gas giants.

techs.name: Field Repair
techs.description: Supply ship crews repair 15% of every ship's hull each turn in the field, and get knocked-out parts working again, while their stores last.

techs.name: Miniaturization
techs.description: Smaller parts: +1 slot on every hull.

techs.name: Gas Giant Habitats
techs.description: Unlocks the Habitat Module: a costly ship that founds a floating colony on a gas giant (up to 5 people, no farming).

techs.name: Damage Control
techs.description: Every ship repairs 10% of its hull each turn, anywhere.

techs.name: Fighter Squadrons
techs.description: Unlocks the Fighter Bay for cruisers and larger.

techs.name: Flight Operations
techs.description: Every hangar launches one more craft.

techs.name: Strike Drones
techs.description: Unlocks the Strike Drone Bay for battleships and larger.

techs.name: Fleet Command
techs.description: Unlocks the Fleet Command Network for battleships and dreadnoughts.

techs.name: Battle Coordination AI
techs.description: Command networks give +5% more accuracy; +1 maneuver for every ship.

techs.name: Data Theft
techs.description: +25% chance to capture a tech when taking a colony; +10% sabotage odds.

techs.name: Warp Gates
techs.description: Unlocks the Warp Gate: a fleet at a colony with one can jump to any other of your gated colonies in a single turn.

techs.name: Hit-and-Run Doctrine
techs.description: +5% evasion; retreating fleets take no parting shots.

techs.name: Long-Range Tanks
techs.description: +3 turns of supply for every ship.

techs.name: Solar Sails
techs.description: Fleets use no supply while travelling between systems.

techs.name: Tractor Beams
techs.description: Enemies fleeing your fleets take a full round of parting shots.

techs.name: Inertialess Drive
techs.description: +30 speed and +1 maneuver for every ship.

techs.name: Improved Scanners
techs.description: +50 sensor range for ships and colonies.

techs.name: Point Defense
techs.description: Unlocks Point Defense against missiles and fighters.

techs.name: Electronic Warfare
techs.description: Unlocks the ECM Jammer against missiles and fighters.

techs.name: Deep Space Arrays
techs.description: +80 sensor range for ships and colonies.

techs.name: Long-Range Probes
techs.description: +60 sensor range for ships and colonies.

techs.name: Cloaking
techs.description: Unlocks the Cloaking Device for small ships.

techs.name: Stealth Hulls
techs.description: Cloaking Devices fit hulls of any size.

techs.name: Holographic Decoys
techs.description: +5% evasion for every ship; enemies aiming at your flagships pick the wrong ship half the time.

techs.name: Tachyon Scanners
techs.description: See cloaked fleets at full sensor range.

techs.name: Galactic Survey
techs.description: Charts every system in the galaxy.

techs.name: Sensor Spoofing
techs.description: Rivals see your fleets at half their real strength.

techs.name: Extended Tanks
techs.description: +3 turns of supply for every ship. Unlocks the Supply Hold for supply ships.

techs.name: Mine Warfare
techs.description: Unlocks Minefields and the Mine Layer.

techs.name: Supply Lines
techs.description: +2 turns of supply for every ship.

techs.name: Forward Depots
techs.description: Upgrade combat outposts to supply depots that resupply and repair your fleets.

techs.name: Mobile Shipyards
techs.description: Ships cost 10% less; every ship repairs 5% a turn anywhere.

techs.name: Asteroid Mining
techs.description: Mining outposts on asteroid fields: income, but no defenses.

techs.name: Gas Giant Harvesting
techs.description: Mining outposts can also be built on gas giants.

techs.name: Deep Space Habitats
techs.description: Mining outposts earn twice as much.

techs.name: Special Operations
techs.description: Unlocks Commando Teams for sabotage missions.

techs.name: Orbital Bombardment
techs.description: Unlocks the Orbital Bomb Bay for cruisers and larger.

techs.name: Bioweapons
techs.description: Unlocks the Plague Bomb for cruisers and larger: bombardment that kills three times as many people, and leaves a planet it empties blighted for 100 turns.

techs.name: Planetary Restoration
techs.description: Cleanses plague-blighted worlds: you can settle a blighted planet, which cures it.

techs.name: Planet Cracker
techs.description: Unlocks the Planet Cracker: a dreadnought weapon taking 6 slots that destroys a colony outright once its orbital defenses are down.

techs.name: Flak Batteries
techs.description: Unlocks the Flak Battery: a short-range gun that doubles as point defense.

techs.name: Ion Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Ion Cannon, which wears down enemy shields for the rest of a battle.

techs.name: EMP Torpedoes
techs.description: Unlocks the EMP Torpedo: light damage, but every hit knocks out a part of the target.

techs.name: Graviton Weapons
techs.description: Unlocks the Graviton Lance: its hits hold the enemy fleet in the battle, unable to withdraw.

techs.name: Nanite Weapons
techs.description: Unlocks the Nanite Swarm: nanites keep eating a ship they hit for three more rounds, through its shields.

techs.name: Phase Torpedoes
techs.description: Unlocks the Phase Torpedo, which slips past point defense and screens to strike support ships.

techs.name: Singularity Charges
techs.description: Unlocks the Singularity Charge for battleships and larger: a hit strikes every ship in the target's fleet.

techs.name: Mass Accelerator Mines
techs.description: Your mines hit twice as hard, each hit knocks out a part, and a fleet they hit can't withdraw from a battle that turn.

techs.name: Hunter-Killer Satellites
techs.description: Unlocks Hunter-Killer Satellites: a colony's swarm keeps firing on enemy ships in orbit even after its main defenses fall.

techs.name: Phase Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Phase Cannon. +10% weapon damage.

techs.name: Swarm Missiles
techs.description: Unlocks Swarm Missile racks: three small missiles a salvo.

techs.name: Starburst Torpedoes
techs.description: Unlocks the Starburst Torpedo. +10% weapon damage.

techs.name: Gauss Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Gauss Cannon: short-range, shield-piercing.

techs.name: Spinal Mass Driver
techs.description: Unlocks the Spinal Mass Driver for battleships and larger.

techs.name: Disruptor Cannons
techs.description: Unlocks the Disruptor Cannon. +10% weapon damage.

techs.name: Deflector Shields
techs.description: Unlocks the Deflector I and Shield Generators.

techs.name: Orbital Fortresses
techs.description: +15% colony defenses. Unlocks the Orbital Fortress.

techs.name: Self-Repairing Hulls
techs.description: Every ship repairs 10% of its hull each turn, anywhere.

techs.name: Officer Academy
techs.description: +1 officer for every naval command: one more fleet each.

techs.name: Command Ship Analysis
techs.description: Unlocks the Flagship target priority: fleets can aim at enemy flagships.

techs.name: Subspace Command
techs.description: Fleets can change course in flight and take any order anywhere.

techs.name: Combined Fleet Doctrine
techs.description: +1 officer for every naval command: one more fleet each.

techs.name: Chain of Command
techs.description: A fleet that loses its flagship holds together: the toughest ship left takes over.

buildings.name: Warp Gate
buildings.description: Fleets here can jump to any of your other gated colonies in one turn (neither end blockaded).

buildings.name: Hunter-Killer Satellites
buildings.description: 4 shots a turn (6 damage each) at enemy ships in orbit, even after the orbital defenses fall.

buildings.name: Shield Generator
buildings.description: Blocks 2 damage per hit on this colony's defenses.

buildings.name: Minefield
buildings.description: Keeps 30 mine strength in this system.

buildings.name: Military Academy
buildings.description: Ships built here start as Regulars.

buildings.name: Planetary Shield
buildings.description: Blocks 5 damage per hit on this colony's defenses.

combat.name: Combat Outpost
combat.description: Guns and sensors on an asteroid field or gas giant: fires on enemy ships, stops ships passing through, extends sensor coverage.

mining.name: Mining Outpost
mining.description: Mines an asteroid field for credits. It has no defenses: any armed enemy fleet in the system destroys it.

depot.name: Supply Depot
depot.description: A combat outpost upgraded to resupply and repair your fleets there, like a colony.

hulls.name: Escort
hulls.description: Small hull: fast, nimble and hard to hit.

hulls.name: Freighter
hulls.description: Roomy cargo hull: slow, clumsy and unarmored.

hulls.name: Cruiser
hulls.description: Large hull: a balanced line warship. Can carry fighters and bombs.

hulls.name: Dreadnought
hulls.description: Colossal hull: the pride of the fleet, but slow to turn.

components.name: Laser
components.description: 3 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Mass Driver
components.description: 5 damage, 55% accuracy, short range.

components.name: Fusion Beam
components.description: 6 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Nuclear Missile
components.description: 12 damage, 50% accuracy, long range. Missile: point defense can shoot it down. 3 salvos, then it must rearm at a colony or depot.

components.name: Titanium Armor
components.description: +8 hit points.

components.name: Neutronium Armor
components.description: +18 hit points.

components.name: Deflector I
components.description: Blocks 1 damage per hit.

components.name: Deflector III
components.description: Blocks 3 damage per hit.

components.name: Afterburner
components.description: +25 speed.

components.name: Sensor Array
components.description: +120 sensor range.

components.name: Colony Pod
components.description: Founds a colony; the ship is used up.

components.name: Habitat Module
components.description: Founds a floating colony on a gas giant (up to 5 people, no farming); the ship is used up.

components.name: Fuel Tank
components.description: +4 turns of supply for the whole fleet.

components.name: Troop Pod
components.description: Carries 5 ground troops for invasions.

components.name: Mine Layer
components.description: Lays 10 mine strength per turn where the fleet waits.

components.name: Gauss Cannon
components.description: 9 damage, 65% accuracy, short range. Pierces shields.

components.name: Hellfire Missile
components.description: 16 damage, 60% accuracy, long range. Missile. 3 salvos, then it must rearm at a colony or depot.

components.name: Plasma Lance
components.description: 11 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Starburst Torpedo
components.description: 26 damage, 55% accuracy, long range. Missile. 2 salvos, then it must rearm at a colony or depot.

components.name: Disruptor Cannon
components.description: 16 damage, 70% accuracy, short range. Pierces shields.

components.name: Fighter Bay
components.description: Launches 3 fighters: 4 damage, 80% accuracy each, any range. They hunt support ships and slip past screens; point defense shoots them down. Cruiser or larger.

components.name: Strike Drone Bay
components.description: Launches 4 drones: 6 damage, 85% accuracy each, any range. Like fighters. Battleship or larger.

components.name: Point Defense
components.description: Each mount gives a 15% chance to shoot down every missile or fighter aimed at its fleet (up to 60%).

components.name: Targeting Computer
components.description: +15% accuracy for this ship's weapons.

components.name: ECM Jammer
components.description: Missiles and fighters aimed at this ship are 25% less likely to hit.

components.name: Cyber Warfare Suite
components.description: Each round, a 15% chance per suite in the fleet to shut down each enemy ship's weapons for the round (up to 40%).

components.name: Hardened Firewall
components.description: Cuts the enemy's cyber attack chance against this fleet by 15%.

components.name: Combat Thrusters
components.description: +1 maneuver: helps the fleet set the battle range, +3% evasion.

components.name: Crystalline Armor
components.description: +32 hit points.

components.name: Deflector V
components.description: Blocks 5 damage per hit.

components.name: Orbital Bomb Bay
components.description: Bombards a colony whose orbital defenses are down: 10 damage a turn to population, garrison and buildings. Cruiser or larger.

components.name: Plague Bomb
components.description: Bombards a colony whose orbital defenses are down, killing three times the people a bomb bay does. A colony it wipes out leaves its planet blighted for 100 turns. Cruiser or larger.

components.name: Planet Cracker
components.description: Destroys a colony outright once its orbital defenses are down. Takes 6 slots; dreadnoughts only.

components.name: Flak Battery
components.description: 2 damage, 70% accuracy, short range; also counts as 2 point defense mounts against missiles and fighters.

components.name: Ion Cannon
components.description: No hull damage: each hit cuts the target's shields by 5 for the rest of the battle. 75% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: EMP Torpedo
components.description: 3 damage, 60% accuracy, long range; every hit knocks out one of the target's parts until repaired. 3 salvos, then it must rearm.

components.name: Graviton Lance
components.description: 8 damage, 70% accuracy, medium range; a hit holds the target's fleet in the battle, unable to withdraw.

components.name: Nanite Swarm
components.description: 4 damage, 75% accuracy, medium range, through shields; the nanites do it again for three more rounds.

components.name: Phase Torpedo
components.description: 14 damage, 60% accuracy, long range; hunts support ships past screens, and point defense can't stop it. 3 salvos, then it must rearm.

components.name: Singularity Charge
components.description: 10 damage, 60% accuracy, medium range, to every ship in the target's fleet. 2 salvos, then it must rearm. Takes 2 slots; battleship or larger.

components.name: Outpost Kit
components.description: Builds an outpost on an asteroid field or gas giant; the ship is used up.

components.name: Commando Team
components.description: Special forces for sabotage: hit a rival colony's defenses, garrison or buildings.

components.name: Cloaking Device
components.description: A fleet made only of cloaked ships is seen only at a third of normal sensor range, slips past blockades and avoids battle unless it attacks. Hulls of 3 slots or fewer.

components.name: Supply Hold
components.description: Carries 20 ship-turns of stores. In the field the fleet draws a turn of supply from them each turn (one ship-turn per ship), and they reload spent missile launchers (one per ship). With Field Repair the crew also mends every ship. Refilled at colonies and depots.

components.name: Fleet Command Network
components.description: While this ship survives in a fleet formed under a naval command, every ship in the fleet gets +10% accuracy and +5% evasion, and the fleet maneuvers as one (+1 maneuver). As the flagship it adds 6 points to its command. Battleship or larger.

components.name: Particle Beam
components.description: 14 damage, 80% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Phase Cannon
components.description: 20 damage, 80% accuracy, medium range.

components.name: Swarm Missile Rack
components.description: Three 7-damage missiles a round, 70% accuracy, long range. Missiles. 3 salvos, then it must rearm at a colony or depot.

components.name: Spinal Mass Driver
components.description: One 45-damage shot, 70% accuracy, medium range, pierces shields. Battleship or larger.

components.name: Reactive Armor
components.description: +50 hit points.

modes.name: 200 turns
modes.description: The highest score after 200 turns wins. Holding half the galaxy's population, or outlasting every rival, wins early.

modes.name: 400 turns
modes.description: A longer game: the highest score after 400 turns wins. Holding half the galaxy's population, or outlasting every rival, wins early.

modes.name: Domination
modes.description: No turn limit. Hold 75% of the galaxy's population, or outlast every rival.

modes.name: Total domination
modes.description: No turn limit. Hold all of the galaxy's population: every rival colony taken or destroyed.

aiPersonalities.name: Expansionist
aiPersonalities.description: Settles everything it can reach and defends what it holds.

aiPersonalities.name: Turtle
aiPersonalities.description: Builds up behind strong defenses and rarely strikes first.

aiPersonalities.name: Raider
aiPersonalities.description: Fast, cheap ships that hit weak colonies and run.

aiPersonalities.name: Warlord
aiPersonalities.description: Builds a big battle fleet and goes looking for a fight.

aiPersonalities.name: Technocrat
aiPersonalities.description: Out-researches rivals and fights with better ships.

difficulties.name: Easy
difficulties.description: AI empires produce and research 25% less.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.description: AI empires produce, research and earn 40% more and see further.

taxLevels.name: Low
taxLevels.description: A credit per 4 population. Content citizens: +20% growth.

taxLevels.name: High
taxLevels.description: 3 credits per 4 population. Grumbling: -20% growth, -5% industry.

taxLevels.name: Crushing
taxLevels.description: A credit per population. Unrest: -40% growth, -10% industry and research.

species.name: Kraal
species.description: A hive that never stops working.

species.name: Aviari
species.description: Born to the void; their ships are swift.

species.name: Lithari
species.description: Living stone that thrives on dead worlds.
traits: Can settle hostile worlds (-30 habitability needed)

researchSchools.name: Genetic Engineering
researchSchools.description: Bigger, hardier, smarter populations.

researchSchools.name: Gaia Ecology
researchSchools.description: Food and living worlds.

researchSchools.name: Cybernetics
researchSchools.description: Implants for scientists, soldiers and crews.

researchSchools.name: Heavy Industry
researchSchools.description: Industry and cheaper ships.

researchSchools.name: Ship Architecture
researchSchools.description: Tougher hulls, miniaturized parts and damage control.

researchSchools.name: Carrier Doctrine
researchSchools.description: Fighters and strike drones.

researchSchools.name: Artificial Intelligence
researchSchools.description: Thinking machines for research and industry.

researchSchools.name: Command & Control
researchSchools.description: Fleet command networks.

researchSchools.name: Cyber Warfare
researchSchools.description: Hacking enemy ships, defending your own, stealing secrets.

researchSchools.name: Fast Attack
researchSchools.description: Agility, hit-and-run and raw speed.

researchSchools.name: Deep Space
researchSchools.description: Range: more supply and travel without spending it.

researchSchools.name: Gravitics
researchSchools.description: Tractor beams, gravity wells and inertialess drives.

researchSchools.name: Stealth
researchSchools.description: Cloaking for any ship, and decoys.

researchSchools.name: Surveillance
researchSchools.description: See cloaked ships, spy, chart the galaxy.

researchSchools.name: Countermeasures
researchSchools.description: Jamming and spoofing to make your fleets hard to hit and hard to read.

researchSchools.name: Supply Chain
researchSchools.description: Supply ships, depots and mobile shipyards.

researchSchools.name: Mining & Outposts
researchSchools.description: Mining outposts and their income.

researchSchools.name: Mercantile
researchSchools.description: Credits, trade and cheaper buying.

researchSchools.name: Beam Weapons
researchSchools.description: Accurate medium-range beams.

researchSchools.name: Missiles
researchSchools.description: Long-range missiles and torpedoes.

researchSchools.name: Kinetics
researchSchools.description: Short-range, shield-piercing guns and the spinal mass driver.

researchSchools.name: Fortress
researchSchools.description: Planetary shields, star fortresses, citadel worlds.

researchSchools.name: Armor
researchSchools.description: Heavier armor and self-repairing hulls.

researchSchools.name: Shields & Assault
researchSchools.description: Strong shields, invasion doctrine and elite commandos.
